explain.title: What is a workspace?
explain.text: A workspace is an isolated working space that gathers everything of one ALERTE project: countries, institutions, knowledge bases, mandates, agents, permissions, scenarios, exercises and reports. Two workspaces never see each other's data. You need one to do anything in ALERTE, and you reach it with a token.
explain.first: First start, or a new project: create a workspace on the left. You receive an owner token, shown only once: copy it.
explain.existing: You already have a workspace: paste its token on the right (owner, facilitator, observer or auditor).
explain.demo: To try ALERTE quickly, create one workspace named « ALERTE — Demonstration » and follow the guide: docs/runbooks/guide-test-complet-interface.md.
